1.explanation:
• grid.config.js – this file defines the breakpoints and column layouts used in the live grid preview (including the max breakpoint container width of 1584px), so if the margin around that container is wrong it likely needs updating here or in its associated SCSS.  
• grid-test.js – the Jest/Sass test that renders the grid CSS; it will need to assert the new 24px margin or import the updated variables.  
• grid-test.js.snap – the snapshot of the generated grid CSS; it will need to be updated to reflect the changed max-breakpoint margin from 16px to 24px.
1.bug_scenario: The Carbon grid preview for the “max” breakpoint is rendering the outer margin (gutter) at 16px on either side instead of the 24px margin shown in the Sketch spec and on the Carbon website. In the screenshots the grey area flanking the 1584px-wide grid is only 16px wide, but the docs call for a 24px margin at the max breakpoint.
